title: Stale copies of get_diel.py / out_librpa.py in a stage build pyatb_librpa_df from the full MP grid and ignore symmetry
symptom: The same-named get_diel.py and out_librpa.py differ between /data/home/df_iopcas_ghj/gw/GaAs/k6_foraux_xshrink and the CaMg2N2 stage, and it was unclear which is correct, so results from the two cases are not comparable ('哪个是对的').
root_cause: The copies in GaAs/k6_foraux_xshrink are the updated version that handles symrot_k.txt and IBZ weights; the copies used by the CaMg2N2 stage are the older version that only generates pyatb_librpa_df on the full MP mesh, ignoring the symmetry-reduced k set and its weights. Same-named scripts in different case directories are not equivalent.
minimal_fix: Replace the stage's get_diel.py and out_librpa.py with the updated versions from /data/home/df_iopcas_ghj/gw/GaAs/k6_foraux_xshrink (the ones reading symrot_k.txt and IBZ weights) and regenerate pyatb_librpa_df so the head/wing path uses the correctly weighted IBZ k set.
validation: diff the two script pairs to confirm the stage copies now contain the symrot_k.txt / IBZ-weight handling, then regenerate pyatb_librpa_df and check the produced k list and weights match the symmetry-reduced set rather than the full MP grid.
avoid: Do not keep running the stage with the old scripts 'just to compare' (mixing an old workflow copy into a new stage contaminates later audits), and do not assume same-named scripts in different case directories are equivalent.

parameters.get_diel_py: use the GaAs/k6_foraux_xshrink version (handles symrot_k.txt and IBZ weights)
parameters.pyatb_librpa_df: regenerate after switching scripts; do not reuse the full-MP-grid output
